_doc: Accounts (GDD 4.16, 4.18, D15) [balance]. ledger_detail_years: years of detailed entries kept (2 years = 16 days); older entries are summed into ledger.summaries by year, category and building. ledger_days_view: days of the 'by day' tab. notices_keep_years: a notice older than this goes away (at dawn). loan_warn_days: urgent notices when the loan (or its extension) falls due within these days. upkeep_damage_days: days of unpaid upkeep after which the building becomes damaged (D15 = b); it goes back to normal when the debt is settled.

emergency._doc: Equilibrio 2 (docs/decisiones.json, GDD 4.16 «Sin salida», sim/balance/emergency.gd) [balance]. A human family with less than gold_below of gold and goods (storage, bags, errands at the sell price) worth less than stock_below, and no emergency loan open, is offered the moneylender's emergency loan: amount now, amount × (1 + interest) owed in term_days (then the usual extension: extension_seasons with extension_surcharge and overdue_reputation), at most max_per_year a year. Upkeep owed to the town of seize_upkeep_debt or more (at dawn), or an emergency loan whose extension is not covered, seizes the most valuable good that is not the home (another building, a cart, a piece of equipment) at seize_rate of its value; with nothing to seize, ruin (D18).

pecha._doc: Equilibrio 5 (docs/decisiones.json, GDD 4.19 sumideros, sim/balance/pecha.gd) [balance]: at the close of each year every family with a business pays on its wealth (gold + its buildings' goods at the sell price) the rate of each bracket [from, rate] on the part above `from` (marginal). What its gold does not cover is owed to the town like a fine (fine_loan). years_kept: the years kept in families.pecha_log.
